proposed_statement_changes.reason: The directive requires the intrinsic, algorithm-independent obstruction to be the headline, fixes the witness to a ternary W alphabet, and narrows every identification and countermodel quantifier to the explicit fixed-decoder family. The frozen nonrationality and fiber-constancy conclusions already imply the added no-two-output-procedure consequence; the replacement makes that consequence and its restricted-submodel scope explicit.

proposed.def: The family obtained by holding fixed every source alphabet and structural decoder table encoded by \(I\) and varying only the independent labeled-source masses over the legal parameter set.
proposed.role: Same-explicit-instance quantifier for identification and countermodel claims.

proposed_core_edits.reason: The impossibility theorem must quantify over models from the same explicit decoder instance, not over all graph-compatible mechanisms.
This definition exposes the fixed-alphabet, fixed-decoder restricted family required by the directive and used by both sides of the formula-or-countermodel impossibility.
The changed claim uses the new same-instance family and has a revised dependency and free-symbol closure; the proof is supplied separately in proofs.

proposed_core_edits.reason: The old line reads as though a rational circuit always exists; the impossibility theorem requires the functional metadata to distinguish the causal ratio from the restricted output language.
